reviews.title: Not great - would not recommend
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.Not worth the money in my opinion. Have just completed the killer isn’t Alice and that was a great elimination puzzle book. But this one, after the first 6 clues there’s only 17 possibilities left. Too easy and so much crossing out from the first set of clues it’s almost frustrating. The clues are all given in order so there’s no guessing or planning from you needed. I want to work harder to eliminate possibilities.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Not much of a puzzle
reviews.body: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.I didn’t really get the ‘puzzle’ aspect of this book. If you enjoy trawling through data it might be for you. Some of the instructions felt like they were written by AI, the phrasing didn’t quite make sense. When I finished it there was no real sense of achievement as anyone could solve the ‘puzzle’ by following the instructions - no logic or critical thinking required. I also didn’t like that when there were 5-10 entries left, each clue eliminated a person but the pattern of where they were in the list was the same each time so I got bored quickly.Read moreRead less
